description: Freeze step cue v2: a rhythm aid for gait freezing at doorways and lift entrances, rebuilt as a three-page agent. Four rhythm sets (50-72 BPM, 12-24 step targets); the cue page runs a visible rhythm line with TTS counting, counts steps from head pitch dips on the orientation sensor (temple tap when no sensor), and settles honestly - target reached means walking, time limit means hold on and rest. Sessions persist across launches. A life aid, not a medical judgement.
name: freeze-step-cue
